title: From imprecision to precision in virtual reality: a machine learning approach to parametric CAD modelling
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes a machine learning approach to convert imprecise VR user inputs into CAD-compatible formats. It involves creating an integrated toolchain of ML, VR, and CAD, and uses VR-based sculpting as an exemplar design tool. The system is tested on a dataset of imperfect voxel-based representations of CAD features.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not collect human subjective evaluations, but rather presents technical results and performance metrics of the ML model.
